items.title: 芯片制造巨头台积电发现重大员工数据泄露——有报道称信息在阴暗论坛上以 3 比特币出售
items.summary: The data is said to have been "made available on an external website without authorization."

content.v: TSMC, the juggernaut that produces roughly 90% of the world's most advanced chips, has discovered a data leak said to contain over 46,000 employee records, according to Seeking Alpha .

The company made a Form 6-K filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday, stating: "TSMC has found that some of our current and former employee data was made available on an external website without authorization. Currently, we have found no evidence that TSMC’s systems have been compromised."

The company says the info has been verified to match data "stored in the system services of a cloud service provider," although said provider is not named. TSMC says it has informed those impacted by the breach and is providing support, and has also engaged with the cloud service vendor, investigating authorities, and a third-party cybersecurity agency to "ascertain the facts and take necessary actions."

Taiwanese outlet United Daily News reports that hackers were allegedly offering the employee records on an underground forum for the princely sum of three bitcoin, in exchange for 6.9 GB worth of private data.

The outlet also says that, "according to information online" (via machine translation), hackers were also selling what appears to be TSMC employee data on other forums, releasing a small sample which is said to contain a vast array of personal details, including national ID numbers, addresses, and banking information.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bH7QLm4nDiT56roKxy3bmE-1920-80.jpg
TSMC has confirmed in its statement that the leaked data is unrelated to the company's operations, or customer-related information.
This isn't the first time TSMC has been in the headlines in relation to cybersecurity. Back in 2023, ransomware outfit LockBit attempted to extort the company for $70 million after a claimed hack.

TSMC denied it had been directly hacked , revealing in a statement that IT hardware supplier Kinmax Technology had been the victim of a "cybersecurity incident" instead, which "led to the leak of information pertinent to server initial setup and configuration." Kinmax also released a statement at the time confirming the breach .

Being such a large and wealthy company at the heart of the tech supply chain, it's no surprise that hackers are keen to gain any details on TSMC if they can. In both these cases, it seems that TSMC's own systems remained secure, but an outside party may have let the side down.

Regardless, I doubt it's the last major data leak I'll be writing about before 2026 is out. This year has been characterised by cybersecurity incidents left, right and centre, and in this every-more-interconnected world, it seems even some of the most security-conscious companies are far from immune.

items.title: 塞尔达传说：世界之间的联系被列为“可与 NSO 一起玩”，但我们不要急于下结论
items.summary: An upcoming new library? Probably not... Nintendo's official website for the Zelda series has updated its entr

content.v: An upcoming new library? Probably not...

Nintendo's official website for the Zelda series has updated its entry for A Link Between Worlds with a mysterious 'Playable with Nintendo Switch Online' icon, leading some to believe that it's a hint of an upcoming expansion to the paid service. However, we're not so sure.

The site is home to a series timeline, listing every mainline game from the NES original through to the Ocarina of Time remake. The likes of A Link to the Past , Link's Awakening and Oracle of Seasons are all marked with a 'Playable on NSO' button and, indeed, you can play all of them on the service. A Link Between Worlds has been locked to the 3DS since its launch back in 2013, however. Not only is it decidedly not playable on Nintendo Switch Online, but there isn't even a library for the console.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com

items.title: 英特尔出乎意料地扭转了局面，从 AMD 的桌面 CPU 市场份额中夺取了大量份额 - 奇怪的是，这可能是由于红队在游戏芯片领域的主导地位
items.summary: Ain't nobody buying gaming CPUs right now.

content.v: Intel appears to have gained market share from AMD in a rare turnaround for the company. The red team's chips have been in the lead in performance and popularity for many years now, and frankly, they still are. That's what weird about this one: AMD may have lost ground because it makes the best CPUs for gaming .

The latest Q3, 2026 data from market researchers Mercury Research suggests an increase in market share for desktop CPUs of 5.1%. Now, considering AMD has fought tooth and nail for a decade to increase its share to around 35% as of Q2, 2026, dropping down to just 29.9% in the following three months marks a gargantuan lurch back towards Intel.

Our pick for the best gaming CPU is the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D , and many other AMD chips make up our recommendations. While we do recommend the Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus due to its surprisingly low price tag and plenty of cores, I wouldn't go as far as believing any Arrow Lake chip has been key to turning around Intel's fortunes among gamers. The architecture struggles to keep up with AMD's latest in gaming, and it is built on a dead-end platform—Nova Lake chips are expected soon on a different motherboard socket.

The increase in market share is almost too big to be believed, which is certainly one theory as to what's going on. A rounding error or errant data—though Mercury Research have been pretty locked in in the past. Both Intel and AMD cite their numbers when it makes them look good.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YahyH7DXoTMn98ARxdS5QH-1920-80.jpg
Mercury Research put its hands up to say it isn't totally sure what happened, either:

"It's difficult to know the driver of this for sure, but we speculate that due to the lower mobile CPU demand, Intel could allocate more products to the desktop market, which normally sees a significant demand increase in the third quarter, and Intel had been under-supplying this market earlier in 2026.
"AMD, however, did not appear to have a seasonal increase, which resulted in Intel having a very large sequential and on-year gain in desktop CPU market share," Mercury Research says.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QFKaHEzqfbQE2Xchd4simK-1920-80.jpg
The other theory presented by the market research company is that AMD has "greater exposure" to gaming—by way of offering the best gaming chips.
"We believe another component to Intel's gains here is AMD's greater exposure to the PC gaming market, which has suffered due to supply constraints of gaming GPUs."

Mercury Research say 'supply constraints' when it's more like prices are so absurd for GPUs, RAM, and storage as to be comical, which lends to a general malaise among gamers to building a new PC. But, either way, this theory makes some sense. Intel still holds huge sway with system builders and OEMs, the likes of which are buying up both new and old (DDR4-compatible) chips for cheap systems. And not just gaming systems, which we see both Intel and AMD get a fairly decent share of during our weekly trawling for gaming PC deals.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gdYTVLLSs8hWboonzF5we9-1920-80.jpg

AMD also admitted it is has a supply deficit at the moment; demand is outstripping supply. It's working to close that deficit, but what it means by that is grow its datacentre chip business more in the coming months and years. After all, AMD is a datacentre company now.

I wouldn't mistake Intel 'gaining market share' as a healthy sign for the company or the wider industry. Mercury Research suggested desktop CPU volumes had seen a "large drop" in Q2, 2026, and both Intel and AMD are said to have seen more than a 10% drop in shipments for mobile chips in Q3, 2026. They're fighting for scraps in the consumer market.
Intel has seen a momentous share price drop as of late due to weak sale expectations due to a crappy PC market, but AMD is set to beat Intel for total revenue by the end of year .

items.title: GTA 6 游戏内电视节目 Macca & Friends 看起来很荒谬
items.summary: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is a

others.title: GTA 6 的游戏内动画电视剧《Macca & Friends》暗示了游戏的荒谬范围

content.v: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is about a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida (the stand-in for Florida).

One of Macca's friends is Pinchie the crab, who is Macca's landlord. Macca is also friends with a hat-wearing manatee and a flamingo. Check out the trailer below, which sets up a story where Macca needs to get money to pay his landlord. The story involves the group seemingly posing as cops and sneaking into a police station, maybe to grab some cash from an evidence locker?

Macca & Friends will be available to watch on Weazel, which is GTA's version of Fox. For now, all we have is this teaser. Given Rockstar's extreme push toward depth and immersion, we wouldn't be surprised if Macca & Friends is an actual multi-episode TV show in GTA 6 that people can watch on their in-game couch.
GTA 6 has an impressive attention to detail, so much so that a lot of what Rockstar created, fans may never even see .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading is underway now, and that's good news because the game is 212GB.

items.title: 《战神:斯巴达之子》官宣11月16日登PS4!大更新来临
items.summary: PS4版与两个新模式同日上线，厄瑞玻斯模式一击即倒且存档选定后不可更改。

content.v: PlayStation Blog 11月13日的更新公告显示，《战神：斯巴达之子》将于11月16日当地时间午夜登陆PS4。Mega Cat Studios会在同一时间推送补丁，为PS4和PS5两个平台加入两个新模式。
据公告介绍，赫尔墨斯模式是一套专门的速通工具，包含基于分段的计时器和持久记分板等内容，玩家首次通关游戏后即可进入，也可以在开始菜单输入上、上、下、下、左、右、左、右、L1、R1、触摸板的指令解锁。
厄瑞玻斯模式则把难度拉到另一头：玩家和敌人都会一击即倒。该模式在开始新游戏并选择存档槽时选定，公告特别提示，一旦选定，该存档对应的模式无法更改。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/13/cas_auto/small_0_9412213.jpg
对已经通关的玩家来说，这两个模式提供了重新打开游戏的理由：一个面向追求成绩的速通玩家，一个面向想体验极限容错的老手。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/13/cas_auto/small_0_9412214.jpg
《战神：斯巴达之子》是系列正典故事，聚焦克雷托斯青年时期与兄弟戴莫斯的经历，由Mega Cat Studios开发，采用复古风格的2D动作平台玩法，现已在PS5推出。

items.title: GTA 6 有完整的动画电视剧，您可以在游戏中观看
items.summary: In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, w

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/13/screenshot-2026-11-13-150934-1794582618953.png
In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, we have our first look at an animated TV series you can watch in-game.

The DiscussingFilm X / Twitter account posted a teaser for Macca & Friends, a cartoon Rockstar created for GTA 6’s Weazel television network, which is also found in both the 3D Universe and HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series.

Exclusive first look at ‘MACCA & FRIENDS’. The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida. Coming November 19 on WEAZEL. https://t.co/yLpn1i3ihX

Macca & Friends has big Adult Swim vibes. It stars Pinche, a crab landlord who is going to kick out Macca the alligator if he doesn’t pay rent. There’s a talking sun, lots of other talking animals, and a police station. “The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida,” reads the description.

Reaction is a mix of disbelief that GTA 6 has an entire cartoon in the game itself to watch, and growing hype ahead of its November 19 release date. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson recently told The New York Times that it took him about 80 hours to finish the game back in February. He noted that playthrough included the main story and some "optional goals with narrative ramifications," so it's unclear if he sat down to watch some in-game telly. Still, that is a sizable length regardless. For comparison, GTA 4 and 5 are around 30 hours long, while Red Dead Redemption 2 is around 50-60 hours. So, that means GTA 6 will be the longest of Rockstar's games to date.

Indeed, an in-game TV series is exactly the kind of thing fans have come to expect from Rockstar, which operates on another level to most, if not all triple-A video game companies. We know GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make , but it is considered to be the most expensive video game of all time.

Rockstar has insisted GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make, countering an online rumor, but it’s still probably the most expensive video game of all time. A recent Bloomberg report confirmed that Rockstar Games now has 4,711 staff across 12 offices, up from the 2,441 staff it had when Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in 2018. The company has doubled in size over the last eight years, which will have increased costs significantly. But it also means Rockstar is able to do things like this cartoon, which for many fans won’t be of interest, but for some will be a fun distraction.

Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier said in a video accompaniment to his making of GTA 6 article that Rockstar told him of a scripted system in the game that makes dual protagonists Jason and Lucia — or, it sounds like, any character in the game — exert different amounts of sweat depending on how much effort they’re putting into whatever activity they’re doing. Indeed, Rockstar set up a new studio in Los Angeles packed with writers, producers, and directors, just to make NPCs.

GTA 6 launches on November 19, and we’ve got the global release times so you know when you can start playing . This week, IGN interviewed Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick to talk GTA 6 expectations , Online, and what the next decade looks like. We’ve also got a report on the hunt for information dataminers are currently on following the launch of GTA 6 preload .

items.title: Reddit 告诉我，它不会从 Reddit 评论的附属机构中赚到一分钱，并且正在努力避免不真实的内容
items.summary: "Reddit does not receive a cut of any purchases made through the buy it now button on product pages."

content.v: A couple of days ago I reported that Reddit is rolling out reviews for different products, informed by Redditors' thoughts and molded by AI into into dedicated review pages for these products. Given Reddit says "many reviews also include images, prices, and purchase links", I wondered whether Reddit would be making any affiliate money from this. Well, I now have an answer: the company tells us it will not receive a cut.
In an email sent to me, a Reddit rep explains: "Reddit Reviews is an organic experience, and Reddit does not receive a cut of any purchases made through the buy it now button on product pages."

Not that I would have had a massive problem with this—PC Gamer earns affiliate revenue itself—but I suppose it's good to know there won't be a financial incentive there at least in that respect. And it does at least tie in with the aimed "organic" nature of Reddit in general.

I was also concerned that users might review-bomb products they don't like, or that companies could use bots to positively influence reviews for their own products. Reddit reassures us about that, too:
"Platform-wide, we are taking numerous steps to prevent and enforce against inauthentic content."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5Rn5C8no72U8EXRXMjtPGG-1920-80.jpg
Some of these steps include:

That's certainly more reassuring than nothing, but we'll have to see how it goes in practice. AI and bot farms make the modern landscape tricky business, and I'm sure there must already be actors out there giving pretty convincing supposedly first-personal reviews of products on different platforms, whether to bolster or undermine these products.
As always, the proof will be in the pudding (or rather, for the pedants, in the eating of it).
Reddit Reviews is rolling out to US iOS users and will cover around 10,000 products, but the company plans to add more products and expand to other locations throughout 2027.

items.title: 由于网速不佳，数千名英国玩家需要等待一周多的时间下载 GTA 6 预装版
items.summary: Experts have warned that over 870,000 UK gamers could wait up to a week or more to download GTA 6’s 212GB prel

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gta-6-preload-1794322351146.jpeg

It’s hard to believe it, but we’re currently living in a pre-GTA 6 world for just a few more days. The most anticipated game of all time, and Rockstar’s first since 2018’s Red Dead Redemption 2, is expected to push the technical, immersion, and storytelling boundaries of gaming in ways that felt inconceivable while we played 2013’s Grand Theft Auto 5.

One of the biggest changes since then has been the rise of digital gaming, and with Grand Theft Auto 6 coming in at up to 212GB, players have already been making liberal use of the pre-load functionality on PlayStation 5 and Xbox up to a week ahead of release.
Now, though, a study by Broadband Genie has suggested that that might not be enough.
UK Gamers Might Not Be Able to Pre-load GTA 6 in Time
Broadband Genie assessed data from over 17,000 recent speed tests undertaken through its own comparison tool, and found that 870,000 UK gamers could be waiting the full week for the game to download.
According to Broadband Genie’s calculations, a speed of 2.8Mbps or under will require a week of downloading, while a home reaching a download speed of 9.8Mbps will still take two days.

The report ranks Newport as the worst-hit city for downloading Grand Theft Auto 6. Over a third of speed tests in the city (35%) dropped below 2.8Mbps, meaning a wait of more than a week, while 41% of Newport tests remained below the 9.8Mbps threshold.

Given the bandwidth required, there’s a chance this would have a knock-on effect on internet usage beyond just the console, too, meaning working from home or streaming video would be hampered by the hefty download.
Gamers in Ely (24%), Hereford (17%), and Bath (16%) also face two days of downloading, while 9% of gamers in Torquay and Bangor are expected to be waiting for a week or more.
Alex Tofts, strategist at Broadband Genie, said ”the pre-load window is meant to guarantee day-one access, but it simply won’t save everyone.

“Nobody should have to put up with sluggish broadband, and this bottleneck couldn’t come at a worse time. After years of anticipation following the first GTA VI reveal, no one wants to find themselves stranded a full week behind other players.
“Slow download speeds can come from various factors, many outside your provider's control. There are practical steps players can take right now to avoid being locked out on launch day.”
Five Ways to Speed Up Your GTA VI Download
Tofts has also shared a few practical ways to supercharge (or at least speed up) your download so you can be exploring Vice City with the rest of the world come launch day.

“There are plenty of easy ways to get the most out of your internet connection. One way is to log into your router; the details are usually printed on the side. From here, you can enable the faster 5 GHz frequency.”
Toft also suggests removing devices you don’t recognise from your router’s list of connections to free up bandwidth, and turn off non-essentials.

“Before or during the download, switch off or disconnect any idle devices such as phones, smart TVs, laptops and tablets around your home. This will ensure all available bandwidth routes to your console.”
On your console of choice, you can also swap out your broadband provider’s default DNS server for a fast, public option.
“If your download is slow, your broadband provider’s default DNS server may be congested,” Toft explains.
“You can change your console’s network Domain Name System (DNS) settings to a fast public server such as Google Public DNS.”

Both Xbox and PS5 consoles have a sleep or rest mode that lets you continue downloading, and Toft recommends enabling that, too, while also hooking your console up via an Ethernet cable for a more consistent download speed.
Broadband Still Too Slow?
It might be time to see what a new provider can offer you. You can check your current speed and compare broadband deals in your area at Broadband Genie now.

There's a few standout deals on the front page as well that are worth calling out including Sky Broadband, with 1GB download speeds, for just £27 per month . At those speeds, you could sort the GTA 6 pre-load in just over three and a half minutes .

items.title: PS5 的新图形升级技巧正在扩展到更多游戏
items.summary: Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5

content.v: Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5. Introduced in September, QSSR is an AI-guided upscaling technology similar to the PS5 Pro's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), and it originally supported only Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei. That lineup is expanding over the next couple of weeks to include games like Control Resonant, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

While it's not quite as good as PSSR on the PS5 Pro, QSSR still does a noticeable job of adding detail and clarity without impacting performance. Sony added that since QSSR shares elements with PSSR, it makes games that support the PS5 Pro upscaling tech a "natural" fit for an upgrade on regular PS5 consoles.

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is a good example, given Insomniac Games' familiarity with PSSR. The QSSR update is now available for the game, and Insomniac's head of technology, Mike Fitzgerald, said it'll apply to both Fidelity and Performance modes. For Control Resonant, Remedy Entertainment senior graphics programmer Erik Jansson said that QSSR will offer noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail, and the update will be available in December.

While there's no exact date for when Arc Raiders and The Finals will be updated, players can expect "increased sharpness, better environmental clarity and overall visual improvements," according to Embarl Studios technical art director Mikael Linderholm. Hello Games founder Sean Murray said that the No Man's Sky QSSR update will be out in a "few weeks" and will see the game look sharper on PS5 while maintaining "the best possible" frame rate.

Finally, Paul Rustchynsky, game director at Expression Games, said that Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will also look cleaner and sharper on PS5 when the update is eventually available. If you're interested in seeing how different several of the games look with QSSR enabled, you can click the links below to see comparison videos:

The PS5 turns six years old later this month, and as of November 10, it has surpassed 100 million consoles sold. Ordinarily, all eyes would be on the next PlayStation generation at this point-- which Sony says it is working on --and advances like QSSR may squeeze more life out of the PS5 before its successor arrives . Whatever form the next PlayStation takes, don't expect it to be cheap, as the current generation has gotten more expensive since 2020 and the PS6 could cost over $1,000 . Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden recently touched on the topic, and he spoke about how true innovation from Sony would come in the form of cheaper hardware, not just better graphics.

items.title: 黄仁勋辞职之后，27岁的黄仁勋复制人火了
items.summary: 27岁的黄仁勋复制人火了

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
“你是说老黄他……
哎，是了，自从他纳了那个四娘之后，整个人都变了。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/24835.jpg
上面这么一则悲惨故事，出自游戏《影之刃零》的地图庞镇：一位黄姓大户人家因为私德有亏，被迫吞下苦果，努力一世结果身败名裂，被别人摘了桃子，意难平。
当然，“大预言家”这类的说辞多少有点夸张，因为今天我们要聊的主角，并不是游戏中的这位黄老爷，而是现实中——
他远在中国的一位模仿者，“黄银勋”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/26623.jpg
皮夹克，一席银发、黑框眼镜，挥斥方遒。
他叫自己黄银勋，但有人记得他的原名叫杨洋，来自辽宁农村，生于1999年。
昨晚，当那件震惊全球科技游戏圈的大事发生、行业即将迎来洗牌时，黄银勋还在厨房里洗碗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/30710.jpg
当然，黄银勋洗碗的水不深
他14岁辍学、16岁打工、22岁回农村创业，在大部分时间里，这哥们都不是现在的形态——他早期是模仿giao哥大军的一员，虽说有点无人问津；后来他成了农村拉面绝活哥，时不时发点拉面教程。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/40701.jpg
直到4月的时候，黄银勋理了理自己的秀发，向整个大众发问：我究竟会成为谁？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/42995.jpg
有人仙人指路，让他把皮夹克穿上，理个银发发型，然后随身拿个显卡。
然后：
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/44598.jpg
黄银勋，“出生”在今年5月。那会儿他的本体刚来中国，一口蜜雪冰城、一次全场夜市请客直接干穿小半个互联网。而黄银勋也借此东风起飞，天天带着那一套经典装扮，不再是昔日的农村拉面绝活哥。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/44968.jpg
虽说，皮衣是他自己一百多元买的、眼镜是自己花十多元配的，头发是拿绝活儿面粉免费染白的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/45709.jpg
他曾经害怕被某些法务部门找上门，公开表示“您大人不记小人过”——不过显然，这次先被某些法务部找上门的，是他的正主。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/48229.jpg
黄银勋的拿手绝活，是跳科目三，在人群里一跳，即便开了自动加速也一样自然——当然，他的跳舞环境比较好，观众不会把他身旁的每一个女演员都给描绘成间谍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/51838.jpg
在化身黄银勋这半年里，一直有人夸赞他的敬业。因为他一直穿着皮夹克，从夏天穿到冬天。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261113_lcx_581_6/52523.jpg
大热天穿个皮夹克的人，是所处环境中的异类，更何况纽约时报已经发文，抨击某人的举动“令所有皮夹克爱好者蒙羞”。
但众多作品里，最让人难蚌的，还是他和一位黄仁勋出轨对象复制人的合拍。
是的，这年头，出轨都能复制。
唯一不同的是，这俩人合拍的内容，还是……
拉面。
看得出来，他真的很爱拉面。
三天前,黄银勋发布了一则视频。其标题叫做《黄总一定要挺住，像之前从低谷中爬起来那样》。
事实证明，他确实爬起来了，大众已经不再关注此前的出轨问题。只不过，他爬出低谷之后，走向的是更低谷。
像黄银勋这样的人，不只是一个。
他所处的，是一个复制人的宇宙：各路复制人不是孤立的个体，互联网的浪潮在冥冥中将他们推向一起：神似马云的范小勤、许老板的扮演者米加印，马斯克扮演者烤斯克——四个人一同登台在镜头前表演跳舞，跳《朋友的酒》 ，仿佛是一出平行世界。
坊间有有好事者P了个图，让三个本尊锁喉三位模仿者——中间那位什么反应有点难猜，但我知道右边那位本尊看见会把它转到X上，左边那位没法看见。
这四位大神，各个身怀绝技。范小勤我们不必多说，虽然年纪最小但已然是老艺术家；米家印则是诸多模仿者中最传神的一位，标志性的墨镜和咧嘴笑容和诸葛羽扇，哪怕是大牢里那位本人看见了也要惊讶一下。
而烤斯克的本职，是烤肉店老板。最值得一提的是，今天下午两点，烤斯克发布了一则新视频。视频里的他在带货着自家的苹果时，刻意啃了一个缺口。似乎在致敬当年给苹果logo咬出一个缺口的图灵，也似乎在遥遥回应懂王那一句推荐苹果CEO接任。
和正主不同的是，烤斯克挺老实、在舞蹈里表现地甚至有点笨拙。他不像马斯克那样乱搞，后代也没散播到全世界——当然，无论是他还是本尊，都没人会盯着他的男女关系逼他下台。
有人说，复制人出现后，正主的气运似乎也被吸走了。
自从黄银勋出现之后，正主的事情好像没好过：5月下旬，5090D V2国内通关被卡；6月，BIS堵死海外绕道采购；再之后，英伟达迎来黑色星期五；至于现在……嗯，烷基八氮了。
可惜，黄仁勋不是白仁勋，不然他在外网和所谓“女间谍”的故事不会传播那么广、本人那么轻易的倒下；可惜，黄银勋也不是白银勋，不然说不定能借这个名字，赚到更多的真金白银。
对于看乐子的人来说，这些人存在的意义，是用自己搞出一个个同人演绎，将最大的事情解构成最直接的乐子。
但解构的尽头，其实没有任何东西。或许现在很乐，但黄银勋正主走之后这件事情，乐不起来。
尤其对于游戏玩家来说，真的乐不起来。
在大部分杨洋不是黄银勋的时间里，游戏圈对老黄的期待，倒是始终如一的，想看看发布会上他会掏出个什么新显卡。
然而显卡，早就不是英伟达的大头了。根据英伟达最新公布的今年第二季度财报，游戏业务的占比仅占7.43%（虽说整体上还是涨了）——更何况，英伟达已经从2026第一季度起就调整了财报分类，将游戏设备、工作站、汽车及机器人等收入合并到“边缘计算（Edge Computing）”中。
今天下午，黄银勋在短暂的直播时，直播间所有人都在问那么几个问题：
“你咋离职了？”“离职之后打算下一站去哪儿？”
这些问题，也是玩家们给老黄的问题。
没了老黄，英伟达之后会往哪里走，没人知道——我们在期待什么，期待新上任的CEO把AI和算力相关业务全部砍掉，全用来生产游戏显卡吗？
把时间调回今年一月，那会儿的黄银勋还不是黄银勋，还在老家的农村铲雪；同样是今年1月，在CES2026结束后的媒体交流会上，有记者问黄仁勋“长期担任CEO的秘诀是什么？”
他说，秘诀只有两点：其中一点是，不被“炒鱿鱼”。
而回到今年11月，黄银勋的皮夹克依旧穿在身上，几乎已经摘不下来；而他的正主，已经脱下皮大衣，走在挑选饮料瓶的路上了：
是和皮夹克颜色相配的魔爪、当年喝的一杯蜜雪冰城，或者是和他姓氏相符的双黄连口服液？

items.title: Xbox 表示，在游戏中添加没人喜欢的广告可能有助于拯救游戏业
items.summary: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to

content.v: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to bring more ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, who worked on Activision's advertising push and is now doing some of the same work in his title as GM for Xbox Media Solutions, said in an interview that people shouldn't see this as a move by Xbox to cram ads into all of its games.

“There is zero world where there is intention--written, explicit, implicit, or otherwise--that ads will be an option in all games. It might not even be the case on all features of the console, et cetera,” he told GamesBeat . “Where we want to have these integrated is places where it makes sense--where it can actually provide value in a positive way. Even if that means the total reach that we can have is going to be perhaps smaller than if we brute-forced it, that’s okay."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Xbox-2.png?w=636

Stringfield went on to point out how the gaming industry today is at a crossroads if the existing model is to survive. Many are saying it won't, or shouldn't, but Stringfield said if it does, then companies either need to "dramatically increase the price of games" or "find other mechanisms" that allow companies to make more money and keep the business healthy.
Stringfield, whose job is to help sell ads, said ads could be a way forward.
“When we talk about advertising--and things that are adjacent to it that amount to recurrent revenue, whether it’s subscriptions or otherwise--what this allows for is an alternative," he said.
Xbox chief strategy officer, Matthew Ball, previously said Xbox's intention was not to "cram ads in everything."

“Ads should be used to offer more affordable alternatives alongside today’s ad-free experiences, in the hopes more could play as a result. Similar to how Netflix and Disney+ have ad tiers with all the same content, but at half the price or so,” he said. “At no point do I even mention in-game ads. I personally believe interrupting the gameplay experience would be bad.”

For Xbox Cloud Gaming, users can now stream their own games for free with ad-supported cloud gaming. Alternatively, people can purchase ad-free cloud playtime, or they can subscribe to Xbox Game Pass to get more time. However, starting this month, Xbox is putting hourly caps on how much people can stream before requiring them to pay more.
The ads on Xbox Cloud Gaming come in the form of pre-roll ads that people watch before getting into a game; they don't interrupt gameplay, however.

Video game prices have remained largely flat over the years, and this is part of the problem, some experts have said. Without price increases, the math just doesn't math when development costs and other expenses are factored in. For his part, Stringfield said price increases for games would not be "terribly popular," so he's looking at other systems, namely ads, to fill the gap.

The biggest game of 2026, Rockstar's GTA 6 , costs $80 for its standard edition, scaling up to $100 for the Ultimate Edition and $400 for a collector's edition (which doesn't include the game) . For comparison, GTA 5 launched in 2013 at $60--that same $60 is worth about $86 today after inflation. This is why Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 is a true bargain --it's "cheaper" than GTA 5 was some 13 years ago, he says.
But GTA 6 isn't the first game to charge $80--Nintendo ushered in this new era in 2025 with Mario Kart World.

People like former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden have said for years that companies refusing to raise prices was actually detrimental and has caused numerous systemic problems , contributing to the situation the industry finds itself in. Layden said the price of new games ought to have gone up $10 for each new console generation, and when that didn’t happen, companies made efforts to extract more money from people with things like microtransactions, battle passes, and subscriptions.

One Bank of America analyst believes the rest of the industry should follow Rockstar and start charging $80 for games . If more companies raise prices to $80 like Rockstar is doing with GTA 6, that doesn’t mean developers will stop hawking things like microtransactions, DLC, and battle passes. Instead, these efforts to increase ARPU will likely continue in concert with price hikes because why would a company cut off, or scale back, a revenue stream?

items.summary: The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/06/06/breathofthewild-switch2review-blogroll-1749187124784.jpg
The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.

Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, who both worked at Nintendo for over a decade, made the claims on the latest episode of their podcast (as spotted by GamesRadar+ ). They refuted the idea that Breath of the Wild ruined the Zelda series with its new formula, and instead argued that it actually saved the franchise from a loss of relevance.

It comes as part of a discussion about “new Zelda” versus “old Zelda” — or essentially, the dungeon format versus a complete open world. While there is clearly a demand for the older Zelda games, as evidenced by the hugely successful Ocarina of Time remake, the pair say there is a good reason why Nintendo took them away from us in the first place.

“There has been some revisionist history out there lately, about how the Zelda team ripped these away from us at the peak of their popularity,” Ellis says. Yang then expresses her disbelief that fans think this way. “That’s ridiculous. This series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing.” Ellis goes into more detail: “I remember, I was going to the focus groups, and it was a really dark moment when the feedback [was that] the fanbase is dwindling, this is not bringing in new players.” Yang agrees again, saying that it was “depressing,” and that the playerbase was shrinking “smaller and smaller” with each new Zelda release.

Before Breath of the Wild came out in 2017, the Zelda series had seen Wii entry Skyward Sword in 2011, A Link Between Worlds in 2013, and various HD and 3D re-releases. Certainly, Breath of the Wild was an enormous hit, selling an incredible 34.28 million copes on the Switch. Its sequel, Tears of the Kingdom, came out in 2023 and has sold 22.90 million so far.

The Ocarina of Time remake looks like it continues the positive sales trend , becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game so far. The question now is, what will Nintendo do with its inevitable next mainline Zelda game?

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is out now exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2. You can read our review of the game here , or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. Be sure to check out our expanding Ocarina of Time Remake Walkthrough for comprehensive guides on each main quest area and dungeon, plus where to get Early Heart Pieces, Early Gold Skulltulas , and Early Item Bag Expansions . If you’re looking for more, don’t miss our complete guides to All Pieces of Heart , All Gold Skulltulas , and All Empty Bottles !

items.summary: 近日，官方正式公开了跨时代剧情大作《异于天堂》第二部“吴市”篇章的剧情预告片。

content.v: 近日，官方正式公开了跨时代剧情大作《异于天堂》第二部“吴市”篇章的剧情预告片。
视频：
本作以1915年至1965年间的5个时代、5个城市为宏大舞台，刻画了主角大东真波澜壮阔的一生。剧情预告片系列旨在通过聚焦大东在各时代遇到的人物，以及他经历的重大人生转折，向玩家展现其命运的起伏。
在最新公布的“吴市”预告中，剧情迎来了关键转折。大东真接过了岩木源造的酒杯（象征极道结义），为了在帮派中向上攀爬，他毅然踏入了极道世界的深渊。预告展示了为了组织利益甚至不惜痛下狠手、行“非道”之事的他，在鲜血与暴力的极道之路上狂飙突进的生存姿态。
《异于天堂》定于2027年1月15日正式发售，目前正处于火热预约阶段。

items.title: PS5《蜘蛛侠2》官宣支持QSSR！画面升级更清晰了
items.summary: 索尼PlayStation官方今日宣布，QSSR技术即将登陆《漫威蜘蛛侠2》《控制：共振》《The Finals》《ARC Raiders》等多款游戏，相关更新…

content.v: 索尼PlayStation官方今日宣布，QSSR技术即将登陆《漫威蜘蛛侠2》《控制：共振》《The Finals》《ARC Raiders》等多款游戏，相关更新将在未来几周内陆续推出。
QSSR基于PS5 Pro所采用的PlayStation光谱超分辨率技术（PSSR）构建，能够相比传统超分辨率技术提供更清晰的细节、更干净的边缘表现，以及更加稳定的画面。由于QSSR与PSSR采用相同的接口，因此对于已经支持PSSR的游戏而言，整合这项技术也更加方便。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132209443723.webp
开启QSSR效果展示
索尼还公布了部分游戏开发商对QSSR的评价。
Insomniac Games表示：“在《漫威金刚狼》中成功整合QSSR并取得出色效果后，我们决定也将这项技术引入《漫威蜘蛛侠2》，相关更新现已推出！我们非常期待玩家重新回到这款2023年推出的作品中，体验QSSR带来的画面稳定性和清晰度提升，而且无论是在画质模式还是性能模式下，都能感受到这些改善。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132209358378.png
Remedy Entertainment也将为PS5版《控制：共振》加入QSSR技术，进一步改善画面稳定性和细节表现。开发团队表示：“很高兴看到PlayStation为PS5带来了与PSSR在PS5 Pro上实现的类似技术飞跃。QSSR能够让《控制：共振》的画面更加稳定，细节也更加清晰。我们一直与索尼密切合作，相关更新预计将于12月推出。”
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/origin_202611132209149226.gif
索尼表示，与PS5 Pro升级版PSSR一样，QSSR同样源自与AMD持续合作的Project Amethyst项目。这也是双方共同研发成果持续惠及不同平台玩家的又一个例子。
目前，开发者对QSSR的探索才刚刚开始。索尼期待未来几个月继续与游戏开发团队合作，为更多PS5游戏引入这项技术。

others.title: 要等这么久?彭博社：《GTA6》线上模式一年后才来

content.v: 《GTA6》线上多人模式可能要到2027年末才会推出，时间较本体上市晚约一年。不过，这一时间线索尚未得到Rockstar或Take-Two正式确认。游戏本体将于2026年11月19日登陆PlayStation 5和Xbox Series X/S，首发版本不含多人模式。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794579075_354168.jpg
相关线索出自彭博原创视频《为什么〈GTA6耗时13年、花费10亿美元制作》。视频围绕游戏的漫长开发历程展开，Jason Schreier等人参与其中。旁白称，2026年推出的游戏并非“最终形态”，承担长期运营作用的部分将在一年后随多人模式到来。
按照这段表述推算，线上模式可能在本体发售约一年后上线。但目前无法判断，旁白是在无意间提及尚未公开的安排，还是根据多人模式的开发及运营方式作出的假设，因此“约一年后”和“2027年末”都不是正式发售窗口。
Schreier曾在8月表示，Take-Two与Rockstar近期没有公开新版线上模式细节的打算。他随后又澄清，Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick并未具体谈及多人模式的上线时间。目前可以确定的是，玩家在本体首发时只能先体验单人战役；线上模式的名称、内容与具体上线日期仍有待官方公布。

content.v: 据gamesradar报道，近日，PS5越狱开发者Echo Stretch谈及《GTA6》发售后的游戏数据转储问题时表示，目前相关技术进展并不理想，玩家如果希望体验游戏，更建议直接购买正版。
过去几个月，针对索尼PS5主机的越狱研究持续受到关注。与此同时，网上也出现了关于PS5运行PS2、PS3模拟器以及不同系统固件兼容性的相关演示。随着《GTA6》发售日期临近，部分玩家也开始关注游戏数据能否被提取。
Take-Two首席执行官施特劳斯·泽尔尼克此前谈及游戏模组与盗版问题时表示，盗版是娱乐行业普遍面临的现象，但公司认为相关影响仍在可控范围内。他还提到，游戏的商业化机制能够应对这些问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132129042721.png
针对玩家关于PS5系统是否需要更新的讨论，越狱开发者Echo Stretch近日在社交平台X上表示，自己看到不少玩家询问，为了游玩《GTA6》，究竟应该更新系统，还是继续保留当前固件版本。
不过，他对相关游戏转储技术的前景并不看好。Echo Stretch表示：“目前来看，14.xx版本固件上的游戏转储情况不太理想。”他随后建议玩家直接购买游戏：“我们说的可是《GTA》。大家已经等这款游戏很久了，所以直接买下来，好好享受游戏吧。”
我们也建议玩家通过正规渠道购买正版，既能获得完整的游戏体验，也是对开发团队劳动成果的尊重。

items.title: 看起来《德军总部 3》正在将纳粹分子送入他们所属的地方：监狱
items.summary: The recent announcement of Wolfenstein 3 gave us barely anything, but the reveal of "Nazitraz" tells us someth

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/13/wolf3-nazi-jail-1794575115197.jpg

Xbox’s recent 25th anniversary-celebrating Fanfest finally made the long-rumoured Wolfenstein 3 official . MachineGames is developing the third part of its planned FPS trilogy, and I couldn’t be more excited. I replayed 2017’s The New Colossus at the start of the year, and its gory, executing-Nazis-in-front-of-a-live-television-audience finale was a good reminder of why MachineGames is one of the best in the business, and why so many shooter fans have held out hope for a third game over the past near-decade.

The announcement stopped short of almost anything beyond confirmation of Wolfenstein 3’s existence. No subtitle, no logo, no plot outline, and certainly no trailer. But Xbox CEO Asha Sharma did post an image showing off just the upper left corner of the script’s first page – barely six lines of notes and dialogue. But it’s enough to suggest that Wolfenstein 3 is working with a very fun concept: a jail for Nazis.
No Escape from Castle Nazitraz

Chapter one is titled “Nazitraz”, a spin on Alcatraz, the famous prison facility off the coast of San Francisco. At the end of The New Colossus, B.J. and his allies trigger a revolution in Nazi-occupied America, and by the end of the credits it’s clear the revolt succeeded. That would put Alcatraz under the control of the revolutionaries, and so it’s no surprise that it would be turned into a prison for Nazis, or “Nazitraz”. This whole story began with B.J. escaping from a Nazi prison fortress in The Old Blood, so it’s somewhat classic poetry for it to begin its final chapter in a prison fortress not run by Nazis, but containing them.

Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more. https://t.co/YyX8LrbTvh

The script’s dialogue paints a picture of B.J. entering an interrogation cell, where the captive inside immediately breaks down in panic. As MachineGames posted , “His reputation precedes him.” The Nazi goes by the name of Otto, and so he’ll be a new character for the modern series, but could well be inspired by Otto Giftmacher, the chemical weapons scientist from the original Wolfenstein 3D. Whoever he is, he should, of course, be afraid of the famous Nazi hunter.

From here, where the story goes is anyone’s guess, but mine would be that B.J. is shipping off to Europe again. Last year, in an interview with Noclip , MachineGames studio head Jerk Gustafsson said the team had "always seen [BJ's story] as a trilogy," and so this third game will need to finish his fight against the Nazis. He’ll need to strike at their German headquarters to finally cut the head off this snake, securing world peace.

Well, at least until that peace ends and the Nazis gain control of Europe – the need for the 1980s-set spinoff Wolfenstein: Youngblood to have Nazis to kill really does mean the main trilogy can’t end on a definitive victory. Somehow, they always return.
Branching Timelines

There’s one final line of the script visible: “Fergus moves in to pick up the…”. The mention of Fergus is unsurprising, since the angry Scott is a key part of the modern Wolfenstein ensemble, but it also suggests that Wolfenstein’s dual timelines will likely be returning.

If you can remember back to 2014’s Wolfenstein: The New Order , you’re asked to make a choice in the prologue: will you save the life of the young Probst Wyatt III, or the older, more grizzled Fergus Reid? Your choice dictates some small gameplay systems – health or armour upgrades, the ability to open specific doors – but more significantly, it makes the survivor a key player in the story. Your choice carries into the sequel via a save game file, and dictates the special weapon you’re given in The New Colossus.

Fergus’ presence in the script suggests that this timeline system is back (he’d surely have just been written out of the story if MachineGames didn’t want to include the option for Wyatt). And if the dual timeline is back, it seems likely that your save will be imported, and that there will once again be gameplay differences depending on who you chose to save all the way back in The New Order. With games and save files now being spread across several generations and not necessarily still in the possession of players, it seems likely that Wolfenstein 3 – just like The New Colossus – will replay the choice between Fergus and Wyatt as a flashback sequence, allowing you to re-pick your original choice or opt for a different version of events.

Alongside B.J. and Fergus, a screenshot of lead actor Brian Bloom performing across from Debra Wilson confirms that the latter’s character, revolutionary Grace Walker, will also return. We know that by the time of the events of Wolfenstein Youngblood she’s become the leader of the FBI, and so this third mainline chapter may well see her take on that position by its end.

Look, it’s barely anything to go on, so that’s about all we can glean from this announcement. That doesn’t mean there isn’t plenty to theorise about, though. Where do you think Wolfenstein 3 will take us, and what do you hope to see happen? Let us know in the comments.

items.title: 在您读完本标题之前，Xbox 25 周年纪念主机补货已售罄
items.summary: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox S

content.v: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X consoles for sale this week-- aaaaannnd they're already gone . Easily the best-looking Xbox Series X console thanks to its transparent green case, it looks like the majority of people looking to get one of these are out of luck, unless they're willing to pony up and pay extra for one of these consoles on sites like eBay, where they're currently being listed at next-gen console prices.

Naturally, fans who missed out are livid, and online, they're calling out Xbox's first-come first-serve business model for selling the console, as opposed to a method like a lottery system that would even the playing field. Several disappointed buyers say that scalpers and bots go to all the remaining stock first, as they claim that it was sold out within seconds once again. People are especially mad at GameStop, as its dynamic pricing system had the console up for sale at the eye-watering price of $4,950, not including tax.

Over on eBay, beggars can't be choosers, as people continue to pay an inflated price for this Xbox Series X. Sales of it are averaging around $2,500 per console, a significant mark-up from the $900 MSRP of the device. In comparison, both Nintendo and Sony have implemented lottery and queue-based reservation systems in the past, specifically designed to thwart scalpers and filter out automated bots. Last year for the rollout of the Switch 2 in Japan, Nintendo utilized an official lottery system via the My Nintendo Store, which saw over 2 million people enter.

In western markets, Nintendo offered a direct invitation queue via regional Nintendo Accounts for verified active account holders. Sony's PS5 Pro has also become a hot item ahead of the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, and recently, Sony instituted an anti-scalping lottery system via the official Sony Store in Japan. To qualify for the draw, entrants were required to have a Japanese PlayStation Network account and a verified history of at least 60 hours of playtime on a PS4 or PS5 across the preceding two years.
But with Xbox hardware sales reaching historic lows recently ? Microsoft probably isn't too worried about who buys its consoles, so long as it sells them.

content.v: 这不是一篇很客观的文章。我是在通关《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版后，怀着兴奋、感动，又略感空虚的心情动笔的。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/77fad1889e4851d15b2d630c1deec508.jpeg_mw680water
为此特意入手了塞尔达40周年限定主机
《塞尔达传说 时之笛》是游戏史上评分最高的作品，奠定了现代第三人称3D动作冒险游戏的基础范式，影响延续至今。
这份过去的成就，既是往日的荣耀，也是如今重制时的枷锁。如何在保留原始体验与现代化改良之间取得平衡，是一道难题。而《时之笛》重制版的团队对此有着清晰的认知，交出了一份出色的答卷。
要说Switch 2的重制版有什么改变，最直观的自然是画面。但它并非简单地把画面做得更漂亮、更清晰，而是为整个世界加入了丰富的细节，让人觉得海拉鲁是一个真实存在的世界。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/9e6432c7c68a5dcf179e985e248dd6b6.jpeg_mw680water
举几个例子：当你割下水边的花草时，它们会漂浮在水面上。
地下洞穴的墙壁上，渗出的地下水会汇聚成涓涓细流。
吹奏陶笛时，林克的手指会按照真实的指法在笛身上起落。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/a3e7bea2e20bebb1e0a2b28bb073a90e.jpeg_mw680water
对细节的追求还体现在服装设计上。原有的角色造型都增添了许多细节，比如林克服装上的编织与刺绣，玛蓉的服装则换成了更直观的小马花纹。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/8dac7e58dbdae839d182bc0befb48160.jpeg_mw680water
为了呈现童年林克服饰那种“森林里的孩子们亲手缝制”的手工质感，制作组专门查阅了博物馆中的相关资料，还在现实中缝制了实物布料作为参考。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/5b3f8d2438b3a8c2d9e3e9a8ab186f36.jpeg_mw680water
重制版的音乐改用管弦乐编制，剧情演出也全部重制，关键剧情处还加入了配音，大幅提升了游玩时的沉浸感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/4e82056bddbdc0a1414cc01e6a5b957c.jpeg_mw680water
在游玩体验上，重制版大幅优化了操作：稳定的60帧表现，类似《旷野之息》的道具快捷切换，新增的跳跃，可自由切换的视角，以及陀螺仪瞄准，都让玩家更容易上手。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/95f0d3d0e232fd9f893610827ddea91a.png_mw680water
毕竟，如今再让青沼英二玩原版时之笛，在水之神殿反复打开菜单切换道具，他也一定会烦得玩不下去。
虽然操作方式与以往不同，但线性的玩法、谜题的逻辑与框架都没有改变。以一两件关键道具为核心设计的箱庭迷宫挑战，利用时之笛穿越时空的冒险，都原汁原味地保留了下来。
具体迷宫的提示也更加清晰。比如原作中令无数玩家崩溃的水之神殿，需要切换水位的那三处机关，如今都用不同颜色做了醒目标记。这虽然在一定程度上降低了谜题难度，但整体提示依旧相当克制，会引导你主动思考该用怎样的道具和机关破局，也不会削弱你解开谜题后的成就感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/27e118e31a28233f0efcf5173c4e654b.jpeg_mw680water
门口的图标，代表可调整的水位高度
玩重制版时，Nintendo Switch App里的Zelda Note也是不可错过的一项功能。App除了显示地图、自带成就系统，还能显示各类收集要素的具体位置，以及每个区域的完成度，绝对是全收集玩家的福音。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/2e925dcd484f338aa540a78f6d362782.jpeg_mw680water
其实我是来晒100%探索度的
App里事无巨细的进度截图也值得一看，说不定还藏着些奇奇怪怪的东西，比如：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/aafc00f9fa49c4f553e50411696ad3dd.png_mw680water
乐极生悲？
不过重制版也并非完美，高难度“里时之笛”模式的缺失就颇为遗憾。另外，游戏只有一个手动存档位，通关后无法开新档重玩，只能覆盖原来的通关存档……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/8f0b7c6b799e16976d907846ff07f18b.jpeg_mw680water
《时之笛3D》中的里时之笛模式
出于整体体验的考虑，制作组在尝试之后没有为游戏加入传送点。但以我自己的体验来说，还是希望游戏能增加一些传送点，或者为牧场增设一首传送曲。有些谜题需要反复切换时间线，或是在多个场景之间奔波，缺少传送点带来的重复赶路，确实有些枯燥。
总而言之，《时之笛》重制版值得一玩。
塞尔达系列的灵感，起源于宫本茂童年在住处附近的山野间四处探索的回忆。而《时之笛》重制版，无疑正是能带来这种冒险体验的优秀作品。

items.title: 性感在哪？新晋全球最性感男人引争议 本人也不敢相信
items.summary: 55岁的美国演员诺亚·怀尔（Noah Wyle）被《人物》杂志评选为2026年度全球最性感男人。他曾主演大热美剧《匹兹堡医护前线》。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132110205459.png
55岁的美国演员诺亚·怀尔（Noah Wyle）被《人物》杂志评选为2026年度全球最性感男人。他曾主演大热美剧《匹兹堡医护前线》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132110369617.jpg
据了解，诺亚1971年出生于美国加利福尼亚州，中学时期他就开始参与戏剧表演，创作的戏剧还得过奖；高中毕业后，他决定投身表演事业，参加了西北大学的戏剧艺术项目。他的演员之路并不是一帆风顺的，在经历了几年无戏可拍之后，他接到了改变一生的剧本——《急诊室的故事》。自1994年起，诺亚就成为了《急诊室的故事》里的英俊帅气的卡特医生。这一演，就是十几年。
2025年，“卡特医生”变成了“罗比医生”。目前，《匹兹堡医护前线》已经播出两季，第三季将于明年开播。诺亚也凭借这部剧的两季，连续两年获得了艾美奖剧情类最佳男主角。虽然在剧中罗比医生魅力十足，但诺亚拿到全球最性感男人的称号属实是没想到。因此，中外网友集体质疑这个结果：“连街区里最性感的爷爷都算不上。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132110275665.jpg
没想到的不止网友，还有诺亚本人：“我当时觉得这像个恶作剧——做梦也没想到自己会获得这样的荣誉。”

items.title: “明显的国家安全担忧需要立即解决”：国会给黄仁勋的新信对这位前英伟达首席执行官采取了更强硬的语气
items.summary: They threaten subpoenas if he doesn't show up, but he's intimated that he'll attend the meeting.

content.v: Ex-Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang has again been summoned to United States Congress to speak with lawmakers. On the agenda are national security issues that may have arisen from his, and his company's, relationship with MegaSpeed, a Singaporean-registered company at the centre of a debate about China's access to high-performance GPUs; possible interference with US export control investigations; and chip smuggling.

“As reports continue to come to light regarding Jensen Huang, Nvidia, and Megaspeed, there are clear national security concerns that need to be addressed immediately,” US committee chairmen Mast, Moolenaar, and Crawford say about the letters summoning Huang, Nvidia's General Counsel Tim Teter, and Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler to Congress.
“We need to know the full extent to which our national security has been put at risk," the chairmen say.

This meetings are to take place with the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, House Select Committee on the CCP, and House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence. Huang and Teter's meetings are described as 'closed-door transcribed interviews', taking place on December 1 and December 2, respectively. Both parties are threatened with subpoena to force their attendance if they do not comply with the request. Under Secretary Kessler's invitation is described as a "hearing" and is much more amicable.

It's a marked change in tone for Huang compared to a letter sent by the chairmen prior to his resignation from Nvidia , which simply asked him to offer an alternative date should he not be able to attend. That focused more on Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a suspected Chinese spy and former managing director of MegaSpeed.
The letter to Nvidia's counsel Teter outlines the more recent concerns of the committees:

"This letter is to request your appearance for a closed-door transcribed interview on December 2, 2026, regarding AI chip smuggling, adversary military use of Nvidia products, and recent public reports regarding Nvidia's interference in U.S. export control policies and investigations, including those involving MegaSpeed."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Z26KvRfeJy3zea5FHnBhvU-1920-80.jpg

If that's not a big headache for Nvidia, its former CEO has also been called in for a hearing with the US Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs. This hearing is led by chairman senator Tim Scott.

Scott also calls on Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to attend a hearing. Lutnick is Kessler's boss, and has reportedly accepted Scott's invitation . Lutnick has come under some scrutiny as to whether he was too soft on, or protected, Nvidia.

Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive U.S. technology.I am requesting that NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify before the Senate Banking Committee.The American people deserve answers. November 13, 2026
And the democrats readying to take over Congress next year aren't happy with Huang, Nvidia or the supposed risks to national security, either.

There needs to be a full accounting of Jensen Huang, Nvidia, Megaspeed, and the Trump administration's actions in light of serious national security risks.We don't need to wait for Dems to take over Congress in January.At a minimum, Congress needs to be briefed immediately. November 12, 2026
Huang's hearing with the Banking Committee is set to be public, taking place on December 3. It covers the "significant national security concerns" raised by recent reports, according to the letter.
The BBC reports that Huang is willing to appear before Congress.

items.title: “新型抢劫”：据报道，人工智能诈骗从法国银行窃取了 1.1 亿美元
items.summary: That's reportedly one quarter's profits for the bank.

content.v: AI-enabled hacking is only continuing to get more impressive, and more scary, as a French bank claims a hacking group has cost it €100,000,000 (around $110,000,000)—about one quarter's profits. So not much, then?

That's according to an interview with Julien Carmona of Crédit Mutuel Arkéa with the AFP , which Boursorama reported. Carmona detailed the hack in an interview, claiming it to be a "heist of a new kind", stating the company has the "dubious honor of being the first French bank, and I believe the first European bank, to be the target of a successful fraudulent attack." (machine translated).
Carmona says the hack is "unprecedented in terms of sophistication" and "technicality".

Effectively, the hacking group managed to create fake IBANs, including those from Fortuneo (a bank owned by the group), "to trigger payment orders from Crédit Mutuel Arkea's own account to external parties using instant payment systems". These, "by definition have fewer controls than on classic transfers."
Carmona did clarify to Les Echos that though they use Fortuneo IBANs, "Fortuneo's system, and therefore its customers, were not affected."

‼️ AI-enabled hackers pulled about €100 million out of French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa's own account.Its chair, Julien Carmona, told AFP how. The attackers took material from a hacked supplier, used it to get into the bank and generated fake IBANs at its online bank Fortuneo.… pic.twitter.com/fduRERezPW November 13, 2026

Reportedly, the hacking group used a compromised service provider of some kind to get privileged access, thereby bypassing restrictions normally in place to stop this kind of hack. When asked by Les Echos why they didn't reveal the name, Carmona said, "This is a collective decision by the banks. This information is not in the public interest and could harm the security of the banking sector. Similar service providers could then be targeted."
Starting on Sunday, November 1, the hacking group apparently made sure "everything was done to circumvent controls, to make these illegitimate transfers appear legitimate."

They then transferred the funds to legitimate European banks, where they then took that money and spent it on crypto platforms. This hack wasn't spotted until Tuesday, November 3, when access to the bank's information system was cut off, but by that point the damage was done.

The French bank has since brought in crypto specialists, who reportedly spotted the abnormal transaction on Sunday and Monday "But, at that time, they themselves, and no one to my knowledge, made the link with Crédit Mutuel Arkea".
Carmona says the hacking organisation was "a very well-organised, very well-equipped criminal group" and "very likely aided by advanced artificial intelligence."

It's not yet clear what role AI played here, but it's particularly good at analysing data, and of course has found value in coding over the last year. AI was only recently used by a cyberhacking gang to target 60 firms a few months ago . In this Korean case, though, the gang only managed to make $210 in ransom payments before being caught.

items.title: 《末日神枪》：英年早逝的《半衰期2》艺术总监，留下了一款类魂FPS遗作
items.summary: “维克托的作品独树一帜。”《末世神枪》（Guns of Eschaton）的美术总监海琳·吉罗说，“他拥有非常鲜明的个人风格，任何人都无法模仿。”正如这位已故艺术家的许多粉丝所知，维克托·安东

content.v: “维克托的作品独树一帜。”《末世神枪》（Guns of Eschaton）的美术总监海琳·吉罗说，“他拥有非常鲜明的个人风格，任何人都无法模仿。”正如这位已故艺术家的许多粉丝所知，维克托·安东诺夫（Viktor Antonov）的作品既充满奇幻色彩，又具备极强的现实逻辑。在安东诺夫生前参与开发的《半衰期2》《耻辱》等游戏中，他的作品总是与玩法机制完美融合，从而能够以写实的底层逻辑，支撑起各种看似荒诞离奇的设定。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-13/5776af66e643cb32.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
维克托·安东诺夫是一位享誉全球的游戏艺术家，曾经用一双巧手打造了《半衰期2》的17号城市和《耻辱》里的顿沃城，以极其鲜明的视觉风格给玩家留下了深刻印象。2022年，安东诺夫与鲍里斯·尼科拉夫、福阿德·库利耶夫和德米特罗·科斯秋科维奇在塞浦路斯联合创办游戏工作室Eschatology Entertainment，并立项开发西部题材第一人称类魂射击游戏《末世神枪》。
“当维克托到我家做客时，我俩经常一起看西部片。事实上，在构思这款游戏前，他就一直对西部题材影视剧情有独钟。”吉罗透露，“维克多对金·维多执导、1946年上映的老片《阳光下的决斗》特别着迷。另外，他还喜欢威廉·惠勒执导的《锦绣大地》，以及1973年上映的《比利小子》，尤其欣赏那部电影的镜头构图方式。”
在《末日神枪》开发期间，安东诺夫将他对西部片的热爱与务实的创作态度结合了起来。按照吉罗的说法，安东诺夫不仅对西部片“痴迷”，还对它们“对光影的运用”很感兴趣。“维克托常说，万物皆是角色。”吉罗补充，“当你注视某件事物时，你必须相信这一点……在他看来，除了玩家能够直接体验的内容之外，游戏世界其他地方的运转也应逻辑自洽，拥有内在的真实性。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-13/3156af66e4550aff.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

吉罗在2003年与安东诺夫相识，彼时安东诺夫“刚刚开始在巴黎的新生活”，而他俩都参与了克里斯蒂安·沃克曼执导、2006年上映的法国动画电影《复活》（Renaissance）的制作。随后的20余年间，她和安东诺夫成为了挚友。“当维克托去世时，我感到非常、非常难过，因为他也许是我最好的朋友。”吉罗说，“维克托非常聪明，是我这辈子见过的最聪明的人之一。他才华横溢却独来独往，不喜欢与太多人接触。他常常沉浸在自己的世界里，但也有极强的气场……当他在场时，大家都会被他深深吸引，甚至产生一种被‘催眠’的感觉。”
“我从2022年底开始与维克托一起开发这款游戏，与他合作了超过两年，直到他于2025年初不幸离世。我想说的是，在维克托去世前，《末日神枪》团队已经完成了游戏的大部分设计工作。我不能代表维克托发声，但我确实认为，这是一款完全由他塑造的游戏。”
在安东诺夫去世前，吉罗一直与他密切合作。当他去世后，这位美术总监也坚持按照他的理念和方向进行设计。据吉罗回忆，在《末日神枪》开发期间，安东诺夫曾经交给她一项任务：设计一种蜈蚣状的怪物。“那只蜈蚣象征着游戏里所有美洲原住民男性的噩梦。”吉罗说，“为了捕捉灵感，我和同事尝试过有机风格与机械风格，在各种风格之间不断切换。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-13/3776af66eb9a8078.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
吉罗还提到，安东诺夫会向他介绍角色的背景，并重点讲述角色在游戏世界所处的位置、内涵，以及他希望通过角色激发玩家的哪些情绪。“这就是我俩合作的方式。”吉罗说，“例如，维克托在看过我为贪食者（Glutton）设计的画稿后说：‘这怪物已经有模有样了，你看还能不能再加点什么？我想看到一只脑袋从它的嘴巴里伸出来。’他经常让我添加一些奇特且出人意料的细节，整个过程非常好玩儿。”
作为一款FPS游戏，《末日神枪》的独特之处不仅体现在采用了类魂模式。游戏中，所有类型的敌人都各有弱点，玩家可以通过洞悉和攻击敌人的弱点来快速制胜。例如，当玩家遇到特定怪物时，如果按顺序射击怪物的左腿和右臂，就能轻松将其击倒。《末日神枪》在图鉴中对各类敌人的弱点进行了详细说明，但玩家也可以借助视觉元素来推测它们的弱点。

据《末日神枪》的创意总监福阿德·库利耶夫回忆，有一回，他和安东诺夫在波士顿机场候机时聊到了游戏内怪物的设计方案。“那会儿我们正在设计一只体型巨大的怪物，维克托将吉罗发给他的最新画稿拿给我看。他告诉我：‘这只是个大块头而已，背景设定远远不够丰富，我们得好好讨论一下它的来历。’”库利耶夫透露。“维克托构思了这样一个故事：这只怪物原本是人类，后来遭到肢解，身体部位像癌细胞那样疯狂增生，形成了一层外骨骼，将人体包裹起来……顺着这条设计思路，维克托开始画草图：人类肢体被巨大怪物的躯干包裹，而怪物的大部分弱点都在那具肢体上。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-13/6376af66e44c5033.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
令人感到遗憾的是，维克托·安东诺夫亲手设计了《末日神枪》里的许多内容，却无法亲眼见证这款游戏的发布。尽管如此，Eschatology Entertainment已经计划为《末日神枪》开发续作，并在安东诺夫生前塑造的世界中讲述更多故事。在未来，这家工作室将会秉持着安东诺夫的精神继续前行。
“对于团队的过往经历将会如何影响未来作品，我们永远无法准确预知。”吉罗说，“不过我相信，人们将会从我参与的新项目中看到维克托的影子，因为我和他总是从彼此身上吸取灵感。当然，维克托拥有任何人都无法模仿的个人风格，但他的创作理念和思考方式令我深受启发。他经常探究设计背后的内涵，思考如何向玩家呈现他们从未见过的事物。”
《末日神枪》的免费试玩版现已在Steam上架，游戏预计将于2026年12月8日正式发售，登陆PC、PS5和Xbox Series主机。
本文编译自： frvr.com
原文标题：《 Inside Viktor Antonov’s final game – How Guns of Eschaton carries the Half-Life 2 artist’s unique style into the future 》
原作者： Lewis White

items.title: 克苏鲁卡牌生存游戏《阴暗航线》Steam免费试玩版现已推出
items.summary: 发行商Samar Studio与开发团队HuHu Game已在Steam推出《阴暗航线》免费试玩版。这款PC单人游戏以克苏鲁题材海上生存为核心，结合卡牌资源管理、制作建造与即时探索。 游戏中，失去记忆的主角醒来后发现海水

content.v: https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535917_732914.png
由HuHu Game 开发、Samar Studio 发行的克苏鲁题材卡牌生存游戏《阴暗航线》(Dark Route)今日已在 Steam 平台开放试玩 Demo。玩家可前往游戏 Steam 商店页下载体验，并添加愿望单。正式版预计 2027 年推出。
按官方在商店页给出的定位，这款游戏把《堆叠大陆》的模块化建造与资源管理，与《阴暗森林》的压迫式探索和实时生存，放进了同一套系统里。说得直白一点：玩家要在一叠卡牌和一艘船之间，维持一条随时会断的命。而这条命怎么维持下去，游戏给出的顺序很朴素：先出海，再上岸，然后回船，最后驶向更远处。本文也沿着这个顺序，把这款游戏目前为止公开的信息梳理一遍。
故事的开始：海水变甜了
故事从一个反常的细节开始：海水变甜了。
主角醒来时失去了记忆，面对的海域却处处不对，海水是甘甜的，生物在持续畸变。活下去是第一件事，其次是搞清楚这片海到底发生了什么。
游戏把答案拆散在三处：沉船里的日记、岛屿上的遗迹、海域居民口中的话。玩家需要驾船抵达腐化的丛林、覆满血肉的礁群、沉入海底的船骸，在这些地方拾取残片，并逐渐恢复自己的记忆。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535917_980970.png
值得一提的是商店页给出的终局，因为这句表述比大多数同类作品的宣传语更具体：玩家最终会面对一个克苏鲁式的选择：逃离深渊，或者成为它的一部分。官方并未说明这是否是一道胜负判定，但把它写在商店页的收尾位置，说明它确实是整条航线的终点。
至于航线沿途会发生什么，要先从脚下这条船说起。
一艘活着的船只
《阴暗航线》里的船不是普通帆船，官方称它是一艘有生命的船。
它同时承担两个角色：交通工具，以及玩家在海上的移动基地。游戏的核心成长线就围绕它展开：收集物资、制作装备、扩建船只、解锁新的船舱与特殊功能。随着功能解锁，这艘船会从一条勉强能跑的船，逐步变成一处可以支撑更远航程的据点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535917_404341.png
目前公开资料只交代到这艘船能扩建、能当作据点使用，至于它 “活着” 这件事在玩法上的具体表现，尚无说明，因此本文不做推测。
船有了，下一个问题是怎么把东西搬上船。
上岸：拿得到，也可能回不去
物资来源被游戏做成了三条并行的通道：深海垂钓、海上事件、岛屿探索。它们供给的东西不同，风险也不同。垂钓相对稳定，事件存在不一样的风险，探索则直接把人送进未知的岛上。
岛上不只有材料。畸变的怪物在巡游，玩家有两种选择：潜行绕开，或者借助武器、陷阱与道具正面应战。应战有额外回报，击倒怪物后可以从其身上取走器官，作为资源带回船上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535917_636480.png
威胁不止来自生物。漩涡、腐化、毒雾、酸雨这类异常灾害，会把一次正常的航行变成一次损失评估。也正因为如此，玩家每次上岸前都要先想清楚一件事：船上的状态还撑得住多久。
而这个 “撑得住多久” 的问题，答案不在岛上，在船上的那叠卡牌里。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535917_908633.png
回船之后：一切都摆在卡牌上
《阴暗航线》把物品、角色与交互全部呈现为卡牌，食物、材料、工具、装备都不是背包角落里的图标，而是要摆在台面上、被拖放、被组合、被堆叠的东西。收集材料、制作物品、分配有限的资源，全部通过这套操作完成。换句话说，卡牌在这里不只是表现形式，它本身就是操作界面。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535957_521704.png
与卡牌同时被管理的是人的状态。除生命、饥饿、口渴、理智四项之外，还有一项在远航中容易被低估的数值：坏血值。它会随航行持续增长，需要用柠檬、朗姆酒一类的补给压下去，否则身体状况会进一步恶化。
到这里，游戏的基本循环已经完整：出航找物资、上岸承担风险、回船管理资源与身体、把收获投入建造，然后驶向更远的地方。
再出发：更远的海，和没拼完的记忆
扩建船只的直接结果，是航程可以被拉长。更远的海域意味着新的岛屿、新的居民、也可能遇到狂热的教徒。玩家会在途中遇见各色海域居民，从他们的说法里获取线索，把散落的信息一点点接起来。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535957_303662.png
从这个角度看，《阴暗航线》给出的推进动力有两层：一层是显性的，把自己的船造得更能扛;另一层是隐性的，把失去的记忆拼得更完整。前一层决定你能走多远，后一层决定你为什么要走下去 —— 直到面对商店页提到的那道终局选择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794535957_368204.png
结语
《阴暗航线》Steam 试玩现已开放，玩家可在商店页加入试玩、添加愿望单，并通过官方社群反馈体验与建议。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: AMD 已通过适用于 RX 7000 系列及以上显卡的可选 Adrenalin 更新修复了占用 SSD 的 GPU 驱动程序错误
items.summary: It looks like it's got some quirks of its own, though.

content.v: I reported earlier this week on a bug within AMD's GPU driver suite , wherein a misfiring utility was accused of making huge amounts of erroneous storage writes. Some AMD graphics card owners reported their SSD health dropping by up to 1% per month, but a fix has finally arrived.

AMD Adrenalin Edition 26.11.1 is an optional update, which means you'll need to download the installer yourself. However, according to the topline notes, the update fixes "excessive writes to the system drive" at idle for Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and above.
AMD's wording suggests that older GPUs might not be affected by the bug, but some of the user reports mention RX 6000-series cards, so it's unclear if a fix for earlier models is still in the works.

I also think it's a slightly odd move to make this an "optional" update, given the severity of some of the reports, though this is often how AMD deals with getting fixes out in between official driver releases—by the looks of the known issues, this interim driver might still need some work before it's patched into the next full release.

AMD lists a litany of potential issues with various games, including crashes and driver timeouts in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced , War Thunder, and Cyberpunk 2077 with FSR enabled. These issues, however, match and are fewer than in the previous driver release, with the exception of the Phantom Blade Zero bug.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jteTWZp5xGpn6oEDuaEAWY-1920-80.jpg

The company notes that "visual corruption may appear on character hair while playing Phantom Blade Zero on Radeon RX 9000 series graphics products." I'm currently working my way through PBZ myself, and the idea of turning down the quality settings on Soul's magnificent hairdo? Sacrilege, as far as I'm concerned.

Still, I'd definitely consider downloading the update if my SSD health was rapidly being eaten by a misfiring utility. Buying a replacement these days isn't cheap , so anything that prevents unnecessary wear and tear on existing hardware is a-okay with me.

items.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO后 多名科技业人士公开声援
items.summary: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞任首席执行官后，多名科技行业人士在社交平台公开回应。部分人士认为这一决定过于仓促，并肯定了黄仁勋长期领导公司的贡献。Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney将此事称为英伟达、开发者、美国乃至

content.v: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞任首席执行官后，多名科技行业人士在社交平台公开回应。部分人士认为这一决定过于仓促，并肯定了黄仁勋长期领导公司的贡献。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789973063_537927_jpg_r.jpg
Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney将此事称为英伟达、开发者、美国乃至全人类“悲伤的一天”。他还回顾了黄仁勋从游戏GPU时代到CUDA及人工智能超级计算领域所发挥的推动作用。
埃隆·马斯克表示，如果能够聘用黄仁勋将是自己的荣幸，并赞同创始人难以被简单取代的观点。前币安首席执行官赵长鹏则直言，英伟达让黄仁勋辞任是一个错误。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794573287_809595.jpg
Perplexity联合创始人兼首席执行官Aravind Srinivas感谢黄仁勋33年来的领导，称其将一家小型初创企业发展为美国最具价值的公司，并提到黄仁勋曾为创业者提供个人帮助。
Palmer Luckey、Matt Mullenweg、David Heinemeier Hansson、Peter Steinberger、Jason Calacanis和Lex Fridman等人也作出回应。相关观点并不完全一致：有人主张保持比例原则或等待调查，也有人主要回顾黄仁勋的职业成就。与此次辞任相关的私人关系指称仍需独立核验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 黄仁勋刚离职 模仿者“黄银勋”就去后厨刷盘子了
items.summary: 快科技11月13日消息，据媒体报道，英伟达创始人黄仁勋离职消息引发全球科技圈关注，没想到最先跟进这一热点的，竟然是他的网红模仿…

content.v: 快科技11月13日消息，据媒体报道，英伟达创始人黄仁勋离职消息引发全球科技圈关注，没想到最先跟进这一热点的，竟然是他的网红模仿者“黄银勋”。
近日，网红黄银勋更新了一段在后厨刷盘子的视频，迅速引发网友关注。
视频看似普通日常，实际上却紧跟黄仁勋离职的热点，凭借极具反差感的内容再次吸引流量。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132032227155.jpg
不少网友调侃，黄仁勋刚离开英伟达，黄银勋就已经开始体验后厨生活了。
事实上，这已经不是黄银勋第一次展现出惊人的热点嗅觉。此前，围绕黄仁勋婚外情传闻的相关话题发酵后，黄银勋便迅速开启直播，穿上标志性的黑色皮衣，复刻黄仁勋的经典造型，旁边还安排女伴模仿相关传闻中的女性形象，将热点改编成直播内容。
从黄仁勋的公开道歉到黄银勋的直播整活，这种紧跟热点的操作也让不少网友感叹其反应速度。
公开资料显示，黄银勋本名杨洋，是来自辽宁丹东的年轻人，他最初走红源于网友的一条评论，有人发现他长相酷似黄仁勋，并建议他穿上黑皮衣、戴上眼镜进行模仿。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132032308983.png
今年5月，黄仁勋访华期间频频穿着标志性黑皮衣亮相，还品尝豆汁、炸酱面和蜜雪冰城。
黄银勋抓住机会，用一件花费一百多元购买的黑色皮夹克，搭配显卡模型和蜜雪冰城饮品，拍摄模仿视频，意外迅速走红。
随着关注度不断提升，黄银勋还与其他网红模仿者展开联动。
其中，因长相酷似马斯克而走红的陕西烧烤店老板“烤斯克”马建平，也曾与其合作拍摄视频，两人分别复刻黄仁勋和马斯克的经典形象，形成颇具话题性的跨界组合。
不过这种模仿式流量也伴随着争议，有网友认为，只要明确是模仿和娱乐创作，给普通人提供了展示自己的机会，无可厚非。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611132032361774.png
也有人认为，借名人私人生活争议制造内容，容易突破娱乐边界。此外涉及肖像权、虚假身份等问题也可能带来法律风险。

items.title: 立即以比标准版更便宜的价格获取《合金装备 Delta: Snake Eater》和所有奖励 DLC
items.summary: I don’t think there’s ever been a more iconic sound than the ‘!’ noise that triggers when you’re spotted in Me

content.v: I don’t think there’s ever been a more iconic sound than the ‘!’ noise that triggers when you’re spotted in Metal Gear Solid. Even when I was a little kid, my first exposure to the franchise was through the Mesal Gear Solid: Snake Escape minigame in Ape Escape 3. That’s not really relevant, besides the fact that it shares a similar name with Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater , a remake and an absolute blast that’s now cheaper than ever, with all DLC included.

If you ask anyone who has played the series, there’s a good chance that Snake Eater might be their favorite. Personally, I’m a sucker for The Phantom Pain and, of course, Metal Gear Rising—but a majority of fans love this one, and I can’t blame them. A prequel to the rest of the series, meaning it’s a perfect jumping-on point for interested newcomers, you play as Naked Snake, sent to Tselinoyarsk, USSR, to complete Operation: Virtuous Mission. But, like any secret mission, things go awry.

Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is, narratively, the same game as the original, so fans shouldn’t expect anything too different from the 2004 version. Instead, the gameplay is fine-tuned with some quality-of-life changes, while keeping the stealth combat at its core the same. Just with a fresh coat of paint slapped on, of course.

And I’m really underselling it with the fresh coat of paint line. Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater completely refreshes the original, bringing it up to modern standards, with every element across the board brought to the current generation. Naked Snake has never looked so beautiful, and even one look at different screenshots for a direct comparison will show you just how overhauled the experience is.

In our Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater review , Tamoor said, while playing the game, “I wasn’t an adult yearning for the lost feelings that made me love Metal Gear Solid 3; I was the teenager living them for the first time again.” And, as an added bonus, that Ape Escape mission is still part of the Snake Eater experience. That’s purchase-worthy alone.

If you’re looking to play the game for the first time ever, or you’re hoping to relive your life two decades ago, you can grab the Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater Deluxe Edition for just $27.29 / £22.74 at Fanatical , getting you a Steam key with all of the bonus content at a lower price than Steam has ever offered the standard edition for. Not a bad way to celebrate November.

items.title: 玩家让《宇宙机器人》在PC原生运行 四倍帧生成128 FPS
items.summary: 随着索尼最近确认将不再把旗下PlayStation游戏移植到PC，人们掀起了一股完善这些游戏模拟工作的热潮。夏季期间，2025年的《羊蹄山之魂》首次通过模拟器在PC上启动，PS5首发游戏《恶魔之魂：重制版》也实现了同样的

content.v: 随着索尼最近确认将不再把旗下PlayStation游戏移植到PC，人们掀起了一股完善这些游戏模拟工作的热潮。夏季期间，2025年的《羊蹄山之魂》首次通过模拟器在PC上启动，PS5首发游戏《恶魔之魂：重制版》也实现了同样的突破。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261113/1794572567_816227_jpg_r.jpg
不过，尽管SharpEmu无疑是运行PS5游戏模拟版本的首选，但有一名玩家正尝试让《宇宙机器人》在Windows上原生运行，无需模拟器，而且到目前为止，他们已经取得了一些成功。跨过几道障碍后，这款游戏现已能在Windows上运行，并且通过帧生成最高可达120 FPS。
《宇宙机器人》现在已有能以120 FPS运行原生Windows版本
Equal_Classroom_872在Reddit上分享了《宇宙机器人》原生PC移植版。它通过一个“使用AnyPS5的Windows可执行文件运行，并采用基于Kyty的Vulkan图形层”。
在《宇宙机器人》的四个不同区域中，Equal_Classroom得到了各不相同的帧率：
在Sky Garden，他们获得了32—34 fps
在Hoover Beach，为51—53 fps
在Snowy Canyon，为43—44 fps
而在 Cymbal Party Land，则为37—39 fps
不过，通过帧生成，这一表现得到了大幅提升。
启用2倍帧生成后，游戏达到约63 FPS;启用4倍帧生成后，则达到124—128 FPS。当然，帧生成引发了一些争议，因为这些并非原生帧，但它确实是一种提升性能的方法。
该移植版还包括DLSS 超分辨率、NVIDIA Reflex集成和控制器支持，其中包括DualSense、DualShock 4、Xbox、Switch Pro控制器以及动作控制。
遗憾的是，与近期许多其他PC移植版一样，这个版本几乎可以肯定是通过“氛围编程”制作的。我们已经在《超级马里奥银河》和《极品飞车：地下狂飙2》等作品上见过这种情况，而Equal_Classroom也在其帖子中明确提到了AI。
这发生在公众对索尼和PlayStation的观感跌至历史最低点之际。PlayStation粉丝群体一直在集结反对该公司从明年开始停止生产光盘的决定。针对这一举措的反弹包括抗议、请愿、新法案提案和集体诉讼，索尼甚至还获得了一个“耻辱堂”奖。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 龙腾世纪粉丝们保存了该系列最受欢迎的功能之一
items.summary: Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/10/26/dragonageinquisitionjpg-a2a564-1280w-1415667815153-1666759988152.jpg
Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in each game.

With the Mass Effect trilogy, this was simple: just play through the series on the same console, and your saves are automatically carried over. The same was true going from Dragon Age: Origins into Dragon Age 2. But by the time Dragon Age: Inquisition rolled around in 2014, a new console generation was upon us, so BioWare had to get creative.

This is when we get the Dragon Age Keep . This website connects to your EA account and keeps track of all the decisions you made in the previous games. Or, you can just input whatever decisions you want manually. You can then import this crafted world state into Dragon Age: Inquisition and see your previous choices reflected in the game.

I am sure many of you can already see the problem with this system: it’s an online service that needs to be maintained. True enough, the Dragon Age Keep experiences fairly frequent outages, during which time no one can start a new Inquisition run with their choices carried over.

Now that EA has shut down BioWare , it’s unclear what will happen if the Keep goes offline again, or how long EA plans to keep it going. Thankfully, fans already have a solution, at least if you’re on PC. A couple of modders have released user-friendly ways to adjust the game files so your choices still carry over, even if EA pulls the plug on the Dragon Age Keep.

First up, there’s Thedas World State Studio - Dragon Age Keep Utility by Nexus Mods user anshela. This gives you an offline alternative to the Keep, letting you input your choices in the same tapestry format you would in the online version.

This is much more user-friendly than previous methods of editing your world state on PC. As anyone who has tried will tell you, modding Inquisition is a nightmare thanks to the Frostbite engine, but this tool should make it much more accessible.

The modder says they were already working on this before the BioWare news hit, and the fact that it is ready now is just “good/bad timing." Indeed it is, because the next Dragon Age Keep outage could be the last.

Right now, the mod files have been “quarantined” while Nexus approves the latest version, so it can’t be downloaded just yet. But once it’s up and running again, it should work just fine, judging from the response from users so far.

This isn’t the only mod you’ll need if the servers go offline. The closest thing Inquisition has to New Game Plus lets you port almost all of your unlocks into future playthroughs, but for whatever reason, this also requires the Keep to be up, even though it’s only dealing with things you’ve unlocked in Inquisition.

That is where Thedas Chronicle - World State and Golden Nug Fix by TP1231 has us covered. This will let you access the Golden Nug statue that activates item transfers even if the servers are down. As the name suggests, it will also let you play with your imported world state when the Keep is offline, but you will still need the world state that you made while the servers are up.

While it’s great to see fans get these solutions out before EA potentially pulls the plug, it is no wonder that BioWare didn’t want to risk this happening ever again. Instead, Dragon Age: The Veilguard had us input previous choices in the game itself, so it could be played offline. Granted, we had far fewer options to carry over that time around, much to the frustration of fans, but at least it means we won’t have to go through this again.

In the meantime, BioWare fans are currently fighting to save the studio’s IPs. Most notably, the Save Mass Effect movement has amassed thousands of supporters, as they urge EA to do something with the IP, rather than let the series die.

items.title: “你们这些家伙都是白痴”：杰夫·卡普兰瞄准暴雪的《守望先锋 2》揭晓
items.summary: Saying Overwatch 2 has had a rocky road since its 2019 reveal would be an understatement, and former Overwatch

content.v: Saying Overwatch 2 has had a rocky road since its 2019 reveal would be an understatement, and former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan isn't a fan of how the game was first announced.

Speaking to Gaming World Interviews , Kaplan didn't mince words about the BlizzCon 2019 opening ceremony, where Overwatch 2 was shown for the first time, as Blizzard promised numerous features it either walked back or didn't deliver.

Kaplan said that from 2018 until his departure, he experienced constant friction with Blizzard's executive leadership over game direction, scheduling, and core game mechanics. This led him to confront leadership about the lack of a clear vision or business model for Overwatch 2, and to question the wisdom of announcing Overwatch 2 at the same time as Diablo 4.

"I got in a huge fight with, at the time, it wasn't Mike [Morhaime]. I loved Mike, who was the president of Blizzard, and another president of Blizzard, my executive producer, over announcing Overwatch 2. I went into their office, I’m like, 'What are we doing? We don’t really know what this game is; we don’t know what the business model is. This is a huge mistake.'"

According to Kaplan, the new executives "had a lot to prove" when they joined Blizzard. "They wanted to prove that 'Blizzard's back and Blizzard still has it.' And I'm like, 'You guys are f***ing idiots,' you know? I don’t know how else to put it, but after three years of just getting worn down and not agreeing with any of the decisions that were being made on the franchise and not feeling like I had agency anymore--like before it used to be like I'm the game director I get to decide the direction the game goes. And starting in 2018, I lost that, and after three years of fighting for it back, I realized this company belongs to these corporate people now, the Blizzard executive team, the Activision team."

Kaplan left Blizzard in 2021, saying Activision Blizzard’s financial arm told him that if Overwatch didn't meet certain financial goals, 1,000 people at the company would be laid off and the blame would fall on him. "The biggest f**k you moment I’ve had in my career--it felt surreal to be in that condition," Kaplan said earlier this year .

These days, Kaplan is working on The Legend of California at the new studio he co-founded, Kintsugiyama. The Blizzard veteran recently spoke to GameSpot about the "humbling" reality of being an indie dev and more.

content.v: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang allegedly had an "intimate relationship" with a second Nvidia employee, according to Reuters .

Reuters has chosen not to name the second Nvidia employee in question, but says the information comes from "two people familiar with the matter."

Huang's resignation from Nvidia came as a shock to many yesterday , marking a change in leadership at the top of one of the world's most valuable companies, and the fall of a key figure at the heart of the AI boom.

Huang has been replaced by an interim CEO at Nvidia, previous chief financial officer Colette Kress. The company's share price has since shown signs of recovery since the announcement of his departure, after dropping considerably during the tumult caused by the initial allegations, and the uncertainty regarding Huang's future at the company.

It's understood that the ex-Nvidia chief is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee alongside US commerce secretary Howard Lutnick in the coming weeks, regarding concerns over national security in relation to the initial allegations.

items.title: “我支持詹森”：辞职后英伟达员工站出来支持黄仁勋
items.summary: The now ex-CEO co-founded the company over three decades ago.

content.v: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company after he admitted to an affair on Sunday , and allegations of a second affair came out on Wednesday . Now there are reports of a potential third . Though CTO Colette Kress has taken over in the interim, Nvidia seems to be shopping around for its next CEO, much to the dismay of some Nvidia staff, according to a report from Wired .

It's claimed that a longtime engineer at Nvidia took to an internal suggestion box this week to ask the Nvidia board to consider the company's employees before deciding whether or not to get rid of Huang. This note was made prior to his resignation.
However, over 1,600 comments have been left regarding this suggestion, the majority of which are apparently supportive of Huang. One says, "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss."
Another claims, "We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance."

Notably, not all employees took to the suggestion box to air the same sentiment. One sent an email to the entire company saying, “I stand by Jensen. Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rHCRknkh9ADAkDBvWsWYRG-1920-80.jpg
That email continues, “If America fails the man who helped build its future, then this world does not deserve Jensen Huang.”

Jensen Huang's role in Nvidia can't be overstated. As the co-founder of the company, and President and CEO since 1993, he has no doubt been instrumental in its success. And business has been booming for the graphics card company-turned-AI company over the last few years.
Even with Nvidia taking a hit of a few hundred billion to its market cap in the last week or so, it still has a market cap of $4 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies in the world.

But things aren't over for Jensen Huang yet. He has been summoned to testify before Congress because one alleged affair partner, Alice Huang, is believed to be linked to China. No one knows how the Congress investigation will end up, but it's certainly not a great look for an active CEO to be questioned about this either way.

As for who the next Nvidia CEO will be, many names have been floated , from Nvidia staff like CTO Michael Kagan all the way to AMD, Intel, or Arm's current CEOs. President Donald Trump even wishes for Tim Cook, the ex-CEO of Apple, to take Huang's place .
